trigger.description: Runs when you message its chat

form.label: Kind
form.help: manual | cron | webhook | event

form.label: Cron
form.help: Cron expression (5-field). Only used when kind=cron.

form.label: Event type
form.help: Platform event to listen for — a $lib/events/catalogue type, e.g. workflow.completed, whatsapp.inbound, news.item. The event payload arrives as {{input.event.<key>}}.

form.label: Filter
form.help: Optional payload filter, all must match: [{ key: top-level payload field, op: "equals" | "contains", value }].

form.label: Source workflow id
form.help: Only fire when this specific workflow emits the event (optional).

steps.label: Chat
steps.summary: Conversational chat node. Unwired → acts as the canvas orchestrator panel (no role in execution). Wiring it is not supported — use `llm-call` for a prompt→completion step.

form.label: Conversation id
form.help: Optional: pin an existing /jkai conversation to this chat node so the canvas thread "follows" the user from chat onto the canvas. Set by `pinConversationToCanvasChat` and `workflow_build_from_spec`.

steps.label: glm-4-flash
steps.summary: Ask : Respond with VALID JSON only. Echo back the user message in…

config.userPrompt: Respond with VALID JSON only. Echo back the user message inside a {"echo": <message>} object. User message: {{input.message}}

form.label: User Prompt
form.help: What you want the AI to do. Use {{input.field}} to insert upstream data.

form.label: System Prompt
form.placeholder: You are a helpful assistant that writes concise summaries.
form.help: Optional instructions that set the AI's role or style.

form.label: Model
form.help: Leave as "Default" to use the site-wide admin default (recommended). The picker shows the full live OpenRouter catalogue.

form.label: Temperature
form.help: How creative the answers are. 0 is focused and deterministic, 2 is wild.

form.label: Max Tokens
form.help: Maximum length of the AI response (roughly 4 characters per token).

form.label: Output JSON schema (optional)
form.help: Set to force a structured JSON response. The parsed object is returned under `data`; top-level `required` keys are validated with one retry.

steps.label: JSON.parse
steps.summary: Extract structured data from text: JSON extraction, regex matching, or text splitting.

form.label: Mode
form.help: How to parse the text

form.label: Input Field
form.help: Field name on the input object to parse

form.label: Pattern
form.help: Regular expression to match against the text

form.label: Flags
form.help: Regex flags (e.g. `g` for global, `i` for case-insensitive)

form.label: Delimiter
form.help: Use \n for newline

steps.label: claude-haiku-4-5
steps.summary: Ask : You are a JSON repair engine. Return ONLY a valid JSON obje…

config.userPrompt: You are a JSON repair engine. Return ONLY a valid JSON object. Upstream output: {{input.response}}
